## Description

Points earned per paid visit or referred patient, redeemed as a discount on a later invoice. Points have an expiry.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Built only if the P9-001 intake approves it for the country.
- [ ] **AC2.** Points are a ledger; redeeming shows as a discount line on the invoice.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
